SuiteInformation.Title: Ionity Power & Thermal
SuiteInformation.Description: The Ionity Power & Thermal profile is for enclosure, heatsink and power-budget validation of edge hardware (LiFePO4 / solar nodes, sealed IP-rated gateways): IO-Thermal-Sustain at 3 and 10 minutes brackets short bursts and steady-state operation, with IO-Core before and after to show recovered performance. Pair with the engine's sensor monitoring (MONITOR=cpu.temp,sys.power) for full curves.
